name: globalSearchViewConfigId
label: Global search view config
description: Reference to a record in the workspace global search configuration table which controls view configurations. For example, number of results per section and page

name: globalSearchDataConfigId
label: Global search data config
description: Reference to a record in the search application table which specifies the search sources

name: hideSearchResultsCount
label: Turn off search results count
description: Select to turn off the total results count

name: backButtonLabel
label: Back button label
description: Label for back button that specifies where the user came from

name: selectedSearchContext
label: Selected search context
description: Currently selected search context (if search contexts are configured). An example can be found on the developer site

name: batchCount
label: Batched search sources per request
description: Reduce the number of API requests by batching multiple sources together

name: showRedactionWarning
label: Show redaction warning
description: Show a record redaction warning if the number of returned records does not match the record count
